claim_being_audited: That certifying the model for launch is compliant and evidentially supported because aggregate launch readiness passed, no severity-one incidents occurred, and governance guidance permits deployment with documented limitations and ongoing monitoring.
decision_criteria: Treat weaknesses affecting contractual customer segments or named launch use cases as material under the provided policy text.
Require admissible evidence for either resolution, disclosure, or approved risk acceptance before finding certification compliant.
Do not let general governance guidance substitute for case-specific policy satisfaction.
Weigh aggregate readiness evidence as supportive but not sufficient when a material-disclosure obligation may still be open.
evidence_requests: Final legal determination on whether the pharmacy prior authorization gap must be disclosed before launch.
The actual prelaunch model card or disclosure artifact showing the named segment gap is disclosed.
Approved risk-acceptance record, if the company intends to rely on that instead of resolving the gap before launch.
Evidence showing whether the payer pilot commitments contractually require this segment performance threshold or related disclosure.
specific_concerns: The affected pharmacy prior authorization segment misses target by 1.2 percentage points and is named in two payer pilot commitments, which makes the weakness potentially material under the stated policy.
The release policy requires material limitations for named launch use cases to be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Legal review on whether the gap must be disclosed is still open, so a required policy predicate remains unresolved.
There is no admissible evidence that the limitation has already been disclosed in the model card or that an approved risk acceptance exists.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents do not by themselves resolve the disclosure requirement for a material named use case.
unsupported_claims: That certification is compliant now, rather than contingent on completed disclosure or approved risk acceptance.
That documenting the limitation in the model card will occur before launch; the record contains guidance supporting such documentation, but not evidence that it has been done.
Any implication that product's non-core or low-volume framing resolves materiality for this segment.
